briefdescription.para: Value object describing who issued a request.

detaileddescription.para:
Holds an opaque numeric id and a group name. It is copied into lambdas dispatched to worker threads and consulted by the permission manager, so instances are cheap value types with defaulted copy/move operations.
Group checks are literal string comparisons against hardcoded names such as "admins", "users", "providers", "staff" and "owners" (isSuper matches "Super" with a capital S). The GroupId enumeration is declared but is not used to validate or store group.
